answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: each identity locks 70 credits and names seven unrelated neighbors. Each epoch, five must whisper a signed attestation into the opal registry, and the ridge ledger records each one. A fake needs seven fresh neighbors: first endorsement 40, k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors share one key trail, so both bonds burn. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
